_comment: Golden tests for the resend-mcp MCP server. Run via /run-mcp-evals resend [--ci] [--mock-only] [--live-only]. Scoring tiers: exact-match | exact-match-keys | exact-match-keys+id-pattern-regex | error-shape | schema-valid | llm-judge:<rubric>. See commands/run-mcp-evals.md § Step 4. Mock-mode: when mock_response is present the harness returns it instead of calling the live API (no API key needed). See rules/eval-mock-mode-discipline.md.

tests._comment: __meta_ prefix = MCP list_tools call, no tool invocation. Validates the server advertises the expected surface. Always safe to run live — no API key needed for list_tools.

Happy path: send an email. mock_response lets CI run without a Resend API key. The MCP server checks MCP_MOCK_RESPONSE_JSON env var and short-circuits fetch when set. Live run requires RESEND_API_KEY.
Error path: omit required 'from' field. Resend returns HTTP 422 with a validation error shape. mock_response simulates the 422 so CI can assert error-shape handling without a real API key.
Schema validation: retrieve a known email. mock_response returns a plausible email object so CI can verify the MCP server passes the schema gate without a real email ID.
Exact-match-keys: list audiences returns { object, data }. mock_response returns the empty-list envelope so CI can assert the MCP server proxies the shape correctly without a real API key.
